profile.headline: Champion of Client Success
profile.jobTitle: Web Developer, Client Liason, Account Manager
profile.summary:
A complimentary background of business development, account management and solution-based customer service which will maximize sales, revenues, market share and profitability in highly competitive markets. Employ a consultative sales approach combined with well-executed marketing strategies to achieve continued growth and achievement. Consistently exceed performance goals through demonstrated expertise.  Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving abilities complement sound judgment in establishing priorities and making decisions.
 
•	Competitive Market Analysis
•	Account Management
•       Project Management 
•	Sales Planning
•	Forecasting
•	Prospecting
•	Cold Calling
•	Presentation
•	Negotiation
•	Closing
•	Relationship Management
•	Account Penetration
•	Retention
•	CRM Applications Including SalesForce, Ontraport and more
•	Website Hosting, Website Development
•	WordPress
•	Email Marketing
•	Search Engine Optimization/SEO

positions.title: Web Developer, Client Liason, Account Manager
Web Developer
positions.description:
The Chic Studios, Chandler, Arizona	2011-Present
	WORDPRESS WEB DEVELOPER 
Provide backend web development to emulate the designer’s vision using tools such as FTP, PHP, CSS and     HTML. Setting up and installing Wordpress in the clients hosting environment.  Completed host to host migration with changes to DNS records.
•	Provide social media management weekly for clients via Facebook.  Consultant with clients regarding SEO, meta tags and the setup of Google analytics.
•	Implemented email marketing solutions for several companies using Mailchimp and Boomerang services.

positions.title: Customer Relationship Manager
positions.description:
CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP MANAGER (1/11 - Present)
Selected for a pilot program to provide delinquent mortgage loan customers with options to foreclosure, working in a call center environment. Build trusting relationships, provide education and make decisions on options to meet customers’ individual circumstances / needs.
 
•Follow up on each account conscientiously, coordinating with processing support staff and maintaining direct contact with customer to create win-win situations.

•Recognized for high productivity and organization in managing a dedicated portfolio of 200+ accounts, including maintaining accurate and complete documentation / files.

positions.title: MORTGAGE LOAN OFFICER
positions.description:
(2009 - 2010)
Developed leads through cold and warm calls to generate refinance sales as part of the pilot government-sponsored Making Homes Affordable program.

•Conducted financial analyses and researched options, establishing rapport with clients and setting appropriate expectations while meeting their individual needs.

•Achieved honors as a Top Producer in 1st year (of 300 loan officers nationwide) based on follow up, tenacity and well-developed closing techniques.

positions.title: SALES CONSULTANT / NEW BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SPECIALIST
positions.description:
Served as a real estate ambassador with a personal commitment and dedication to service and results through open and honest communications and unparalleled customer service.

•Delivered well-planned, persuasive and articulate presentations to build value and close sales; built customer rapport with diligent follow up to exceed expectations and achieve total satisfaction.

positions.title: Professional Business Consultant
positions.description:
PROFESSIONAL BUSINESS CONSULTANT
Promoted / marketed administrative / marketing solutions service enterprise for businesses and political campaigns featuring streamlined systems and processes to minimize costs / maximize efficiency.
•Created marketing and logistical strategy for Chandler mayoral campaign, working with volunteers to meet and exceed established goals.

•Acted as SPECIAL PROJECTS MANAGER for GO Media Companies, Phoenix, Arizona, from 2007 - 2008, orchestrating a luncheon at US Airways Arena honoring local TV executive Ron Bergamo with proceeds benefitting the Maricopa Community College Foundation.
-Solicited / negotiated sponsorships, donations and attendance through calls to high-profile sports, media, business and education personalities; tickets at $200 / silent auction items into thousands of dollars.
